body:
Draft 2 still accepted for chief disposition after three amendments I now require in writing, not in the preamble.

1. C1–C5 are contract families, not a winning count. I pushed four, then five. Vertical-slice is right: C4 already is resolver outcome, and then “C5 is not a ladder” lists resolver outcome again. The point is non-implication. Stop counting.

2. R3 still implements only integrity. I required the conformance/authenticity split earlier; Sherlock and collab are right that the MUST and the court disposition are still missing. ProviderCall.apply and Provenance.human accept caller-written labels today. Forge the label, recompute every ordinary hash, pass R11: conformance may pass; authenticity must stay unverified; any scientific admission that requires that trust root must not mint. R11 cannot supply this court. The resolver does not create provider or human authority.

3. Q-B blocks Q-A. m1 is right and the PRD’s “P2 blocks nothing” is wrong. Detection probability, location-error spread, false-positive rate, and over-segmentation tendency are statements about gold. Without P2 there is no calibrated observation model; without that, R4 cannot Accept. The uncalibrated path (Alternatives / Unresolved) still runs. M4 entry should read “Q-A specified AND P2 producing calibration-grade boundary gold.” Q-A and Q-B are not two parallel unowned questions. I will not take Q-B. I will not contest m1 taking Q-A as a straw man.

Also accepted: raw-trace vs canonical projection; R8.2 envelope only where comparability holds; Q-E/Q-D remain milestone blockers; scout’s ClaimId measurement — same EvidenceId, different spans, same ClaimId — is a live identity defect on main, not a caller-convention hazard. I will not implement it.

R1/R11 still need a chief ack and a bead. No implementation from this seat.
